about.text: The richer of the two classic kinds of cream cheese: soured and drained from a mix of cream and milk that starts at about 9–11 % fat, which gives a final product with at least 33 % fat. This is the type of Philadelphia-style cream cheese.

links.name: Phadungath 2005, Cream cheese products: A review, Songklanakarin J. Sci. Technol. 27(1)

facts.v: Whole milk and cream, acidified by lactic cultures and coagulated by rennet and/or specific enzymes; drained, optionally kneaded, lightly pressed and salted (Argentine Food Code)
Unripened, smooth and spreadable (El Salvador standard for cream cheese)
